variants.hair: warm golden BLONDE hair: honey-gold midtones, pale butter highlights, caramel shadows. Clearly blonde, never brown.
variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: PawTrail selectable character color variant, complete animation atlas plus matching portrait.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, not a composition suggestion. Change ONLY the character's hair color to warm golden BLONDE hair: honey-gold midtones, pale butter highlights, caramel shadows. Clearly blonde, never brown.
Apply the same hair ramp consistently to ALL 108 small sprite poses in the top grid AND the single large bust portrait at the bottom. Hair includes fringe, crown, side locks, back of head and ponytail.
Preserve EVERY pose, silhouette, face, round dark glasses, skin color, sage overshirt, cream top, rust shorts, ochre backpack, brown shoes and props exactly. Do not recolor eyebrows, clothing, glasses, skin, furniture or food. Keep hair outlines dark but tint hair shading toward the requested color. Do not change head size or anatomy.
Keep the image geometry EXACTLY: 1152x1584 canvas. Top region y0..1296 contains 12 columns x9 rows of small sprites, every sprite in its original cell. Bottom region contains the existing single portrait in its original position. Preserve transparent empty space. Do not rearrange, remove, duplicate, add or crop any sprite. Do not move sprites within cells.
Style: same crisp square pixels with no antialiasing or new details; pixel art color edit, not a redraw. Upper-left lighting unchanged. Genuine transparent background with alpha. NO background, grid, text, labels, frame, border, ground shadow or watermark.
Requested hair palette: #fff1bf, #f2d17c, #d9ab52, #ab7936, #6d492b.
